children: Estée Lauder Companies nominated Jean-Frédéric Dufour and Matthew E. Rubel as Class III director candidates for its next annual meeting.
Board nominated Jean-Frédéric Dufour, CEO of Rolex SA, for election as a Class III director at the expected Nov. 17, 2026 meeting.
Board nominated Matthew E. Rubel, non-executive chairman of Holley Inc., as a Class III director candidate for the same meeting.
Nominations expand board candidate slate ahead of the company's anticipated 2026 annual stockholders meeting.
